recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色下，淋巴結濾泡（藍色圓形區域）為陰性，而其間擴張的淋巴竇內充滿成群棕色陽性的大型組織球，呈竇內分布；配合 Rosai-Dorfman 病脈絡，此為 S100 等組織球標記凸顯竇內病變（標記名稱未標示）。
features: Positive (brown) large cells distributed within dilated sinuses, including subcapsular sinus
Lymphoid follicles and paracortical small lymphocytes negative
Antibody not specified; pattern compatible with S100 in Rosai-Dorfman disease
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of the lymph node shows positive large cells filling and distending the subcapsular and medullary sinuses in a network pattern, while lymphoid follicles and small lymphocytes are negative. The positive cells are large with abundant cytoplasm, consistent with sinus histiocytes. The antibody is not specified; in the context of sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy, this sinusoidal distribution of positive histiocytes is compatible with S100 staining. Findings support Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.dx: Langerhans cell histiocytosis with sinus involvement
ddx.vs: LCH also involves sinuses and is S100 positive, but its cells are CD1a/langerin positive with grooved nuclei and lack emperipolesis.
Melanoma is S100 positive but also SOX10/melan-A positive with atypical cytology and no engulfed lymphocytes.
Reactive sinus histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive but S100 negative and do not massively distend sinuses.
